products.name: Glock G19X Gen5 Airsoft Pistol, 6mm BB, CO2 Powered, Blowback, Coyote
specs: OFFICIALLY LICENSED GLOCK G19X: Officially licensed by GLOCK and manufactured by Umarex USA, this 6mm airsoft pistol features the distinctive G19X design with a Coyote-colored frame and slide.

CO2-POWERED PERFORMANCE: Powered by a single 12g CO2 capsule housed in the magazine, this airsoft pistol shoots .20 gram 6mm airsoft BBs at velocities up to 300 FPS (CO2 not included. For best results, use Umarex-branded CO2)
BLOWBACK ACTION WITH LAST-ROUND HOLD OPEN: Features blowback slide action and last-round hold open functionality, with the slide locking back after the final BB is launched.
14-ROUND DROP-FREE MAGAZINE: Includes a removable drop-free airsoft magazine that holds both the CO2 and up to 14 rounds of 6mm airsoft BBs for quick and easy reloads.
ADJUSTABLE HOP-UP: Adjustable hop-up system helps optimize BB flight and consistency, while the integrated lanyard loop adds additional carrying and retention options.
